ln:4432084309.descriptionHtml:
Key Accountabilities

  • To bring in new account relationship and hence income to the bank
  • To plan, monitor and manage account relationship in order to optimize return
  • To actively cross sell and promote products and services of the Bank
  • To deliver quality recommendations based on sound judgment, and a systematic and consistent approach in line with Bank’s credit policies.
  • To ensure the accuracy of the facility’s regulatory administration and legal documentation, prepared for the purpose of ensuring bank’s exposure to client is legitimate and enforceable.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop marketing plan, call on target customers and structure new deals
  • Evaluate and assess new credits as well as existing relationship
  • Maximize return from the relationship profile
  • Cross sell and promote the products and services of the Bank
  • Perform timely facility documentation and administration, ensuring adherence to prevailing laws and banking regulations.

Experience

  • Good risk assessment skills
  • Sound trade products & industry knowledge
  • Experience in cross selling commercial banking product
  • University graduate with major in either Banking, Finance or Accounting
  • Results oriented
  • Effective communication and problem solving technique
  • Sharp business & customer focus
  • Effectively manages relationships with all working parties
  • Good communicator
  • Positive attributes to Teamwork

Location:

PRC - Beijing

Job:

Relationship Management

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time
